_why: Sidebar collapse state moved from renderer-only memory to settings.db (`sidebar-collapsed-sections-v1` + `sidebar-project-expanded-v1-<id>`). These vectors pin the observable rules so a refactor cannot silently regress them: the two KV key names and JSON shapes, tri-state expansion (missing key = open, only an explicit false folds), the four section keys, the badge reduction priority (waiting/unread beats active), the show-more pagination formula (preview 5, then +10 per press, no show-less inside a group, fold resets the page), the draft reveal exemption (never pry open an explicitly folded group for a chat that does not exist yet), and forced visibility of the active session beyond the page window. The KV rows must also stay out of SessionConfiguration staleness: writing them may never rebuild a live session (pinned separately by tests/session-wire.test.ts).

pagination.foldResetsPage: collapsing a group clears its page counter and show-more flag, so a reopen starts at the preview limit again

legacySeed._why: Before sections were foldable, two localStorage flags recorded the same two choices. The seed runs once, when no mirror row exists yet, so an upgrading user keeps a fold they had set. Only the exact string '1' means folded.

cases._why: nothing stored anywhere: all sections expanded
the old project-group fold maps onto the projects section
the old projectless fold maps onto the recent section
both legacy folds carry over together
only the literal '1' counts; other values are not folds

revisionGuard._why: a click landed during the flight, so the stale read must yield
several local writes still invalidate one older read
a read started after the last write still applies

reveal._why: an untouched group opens even for a draft
already expanded: no write, no churn
opening a real session reveals it even if the user folded the group
a draft never pries open a group the user explicitly collapsed

persistence.missingRowSeedsFromLocalMirror: a null KV row means never-persisted, not everything-expanded: the local mirror (including its legacy seed from klaus_projects_collapsed / klaus_conversations_collapsed) wins and is written back, so an upgrade cannot lose a folded section on first launch
persistence.failedWriteLeavesSidebarUnchanged: the KV write is fire-and-forget with a rollback hook; on failure memory + mirror revert and the UI re-renders from the previous value
persistence.crossWindowSync: app:preferences-changed with one of the two keys re-reads that row; equal values (own-write echo) do not re-render
persistence.revisionGuard: a hydrate or remote push whose captured revision differs after the await yields to the newer local edit
